links.outcome: Correlation of LLM CGI-S with patient-reported PHQ-9 across demographic subgroups
links.effect: Correlations were consistent across clinics (I2<0.1) but significantly lower among Black (r=0.48, 95%CI: 0.38-0.57) and Hispanic (r=0.43, 95%CI: 0.27-0.56) patients.
